products.title: Sujata Spirulina Face Wash (100ml Pump Bottle)
products.body_html:
Natural Anti-Acne Deep Pore Cleansing & Exfoliating Face Wash infused with pure botanical Spirulina extract for 24x7 radiant, oil-free freshness.

🌸 Key Skincare Benefits

  • Deep Pore Cleansing & Gentle Exfoliation: Clears trapped dirt, dead skin cells, and urban micro-pollutants without stripping the skin's natural lipid barrier.
  • Anti-Acne & Excess Oil Control: Regulates sebum secretion, prevents bacterial breakout triggers, and calms redness and active pimples.
  • 24x7 Cellular Radiance: Spirulina antioxidants and amino acids nourish dermal layers for a fresh, luminous, lit-from-within glow.
  • Skin pH Balanced: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive, combination, and acne-prone skin.

🌿 Pure Ingredients

Spirulina Extract, Aloe Vera Leaf Juice, Green Tea Extract, Botanical Glycerin, Mild Coconut-Derived Cleansing Agents. 100% Paraben-Free, Sulphate-Free, Chemical-Free.

📋 How to Use (3 Steps)

  1. Rinse face with lukewarm water and pump a small amount onto your palm.
  2. Gently massage over face and neck in circular motions for 45-60 seconds, avoiding direct eye contact.
  3. Rinse thoroughly with clean water and pat dry. Use twice daily (morning & night).

🏆 Quality Standards & Certifications

Dermatologically Tested, 100% Cruelty-Free, Paraben-Free, Toxin-Free, Made in India.

products.title: Sujata Organic Spirulina Face Pack Powder (50g Pouch - Detox & Glow)

  • Instant Tan & Blemish Removal: Draws out micro-toxins and deeply unclogs clogged sebaceous pores for a visibly brighter complexion.
  • Fights Stubborn Acne & Pimples: Calms inflammation, soothes active eruptions, and minimizes enlarged pores.

🌿 Pure Ingredients

Pure Spirulina Powder, Multani Mitti (Fuller's Earth), Sandalwood Powder, Aloe Vera Powder, Neem Leaf Extract.

100% Herbal & Natural, No Chemical Additives, Handcrafted Formulation, Dermatologically Safe.
